title: Microbiology

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

• Minimum 75 credits applicable to graduation, with a minimum 2.00 overall cumulative GPA.

• Completion of the following prerequisite courses with a minimum 2.50 cumulative GPA: 

• BIOL 180, BIOL 200 (minimum 2.3 grade), BIOL 220

• Complete one of the following: 

• CHEM 142, CHEM 152, CHEM 162

• CHEM 143, CHEM 153

• CHEM 145, CHEM 155, CHEM 165

• one of CHEM 223, CHEM 237, or CHEM 335

sections.credentialOverview:
Credential Overview

Microbiology is the study of the smallest living organisms (bacteria, algae, fungi, and protozoa) and viruses. Because of their simplicity and rapid growth rates, microorganisms are readily amenable to study in the laboratory. Because their cellular processes closely resemble those of higher organisms, they are ideally suited for fundamental studies of biological structure, physiology, metabolism, genetics and development. The Microbiology department at the University of Washington works mainly in cutting edge research in bacteria and viruses.

The B.S. in Microbiology is complemented by the College of Arts and Sciences general educational requirements such as English Composition, Writing, Foreign Language, Quantitative & Symbolic Reasoning, Visual Literary & Performing Arts and Individuals and Societies courses which provide a comprehensive liberal arts degree.
sections.programCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

92-104 credits

• Minimum 2.50 cumulative GPA in courses required for admission (31-34 credits): 

• BIOL 180, BIOL 200 (minimum 2.3 grade), BIOL 220

• Complete one of the following: 

• CHEM 142, CHEM 152, CHEM 162

• CHEM 143, CHEM 153

• CHEM 145, CHEM 155, CHEM 165

• one of CHEM 223, CHEM 237, or CHEM 335

• Core Courses (10 credits): MICROM 402, MICROM 410, MICROM 413 (1 credit), MICROM 450

• Distribution Groups and Electives (28 credits): Choose two courses from areas a and b, and one option from c. Minimum two laboratory courses (MICROM 411, MICROM 431, MICROM 443). Remaining credits from additional courses from the distribution groups or from an approved list of elective courses. See adviser for approved list. 

• Medical Microbiology: two courses from IMMUN 441, MICROM 442, MICROM 443, MICROM 445, MICROM 460

• Diversity and Ecology: two courses from MICROM 412, ENV H 409, FISH 406

• Genetics and Molecular Biology: one of the following options: (1) MICROM 411; (2) MICROM 431; either GENOME 361 or GENOME 371

• Physics (8-10 Credits): one of the following options: (1) PHYS 114 and PHYS 115; (2) PHYS 121 and PHYS 122; (3) PHYS 141 and PHYS 142

• Mathematics and Statistics (9-10 credits): 

• Calculus (5 credits): one of MATH 124, MATH 134, or Q SCI 291

• Statistics (4-5 credits): one of Q SCI 381, STAT 220, STAT 311, or BIOST 310

• Biochemistry (6-12 credits): one of the following options: (1) BIOC 405, BIOC 406; (2) BIOC 440, BIOC 441, BIOC 442

• All required courses taken for a numerical grade unless course is offered credit/no-credit only. Minimum 2.25 cumulative GPA; minimum 1.8 grade in all MICROM and IMMUN core and elective courses applied to the major

• Transfer students must complete at least 20 required and elective microbiology credits through the UW
